summary: Testing complete for Thinking Coach/Improvement Engine features. All new features working correctly: PreMoveChecklist component renders and expands in Play with Coach page, all 5 Thinking Coach API endpoints return correct data structures. Opening Fundamentals regression test passed (6/6).

issues.description: Pre-existing test coach-play.spec.ts has 2 failing tests related to 'What should I improve' button and 'start-lesson-btn' testid that don't match current UI. These are not related to the new Thinking Coach features.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Thinking Coach/Improvement Engine features fully tested. All 5 API endpoints working: /api/thinking-coach/walkthrough, /api/thinking-coach/principle-feedback, /api/thinking-coach/behavioral-intervention, /api/thinking-coach/mindset-prompt, /api/thinking-coach/pre-move-checklist. PreMoveChecklist component renders in Play with Coach page showing contextual prompts based on move number, castling status, and development. Checklist items can be checked, expanded, collapsed, and dismissed.

thinking_coach_walkthrough_api.details: Returns phase, focus, walkthrough steps, conclusion, and key_takeaway. Correctly identifies opening/middlegame/endgame phases.

thinking_coach_principle_feedback_api.details: Returns principle, explanation, thinking_habit, applied_to_position, what_to_do_instead. Maps mistake types to principles correctly.

thinking_coach_behavioral_intervention_a.details: Returns pattern, diagnosis, intervention, practice_rule for behavioral patterns like hope_chess, impulsive_play, tunnel_vision.

thinking_coach_mindset_prompt_api.details: Returns position-specific prompts with themes and what_to_look_for. Supports position characteristics.

thinking_coach_pre_move_checklist_api.details: Returns contextual checklist items based on move_number, has_castled, developed_pieces. Limited to 3 items, prioritized by high/medium/low.

pre_move_checklist_frontend.location: Play with Coach page (below chess board)
pre_move_checklist_frontend.details: Shows expandable checklist with contextual prompts. Items can be checked (turns green), all-checked shows 'Good thinking' message. Can be collapsed and dismissed.

opening_fundamentals_regression.details: Opening Fundamentals component still renders correctly in Lab page Habits tab. All 6 regression tests passed.
